title: Veolia announces strategic alliance with Ecoveritas to provide industry-leading packaging compliance support in the UK
heroIntroduction: Veolia has announced a new alliance with Manchester-based packaging data specialist Ecoveritas, bringing market-leading data solutions into an all-in-one compliance scheme designed to stay ahead of policy and regulatory change.
excerpt: Veolia has announced a new alliance with Manchester-based packaging data specialist Ecoveritas, bringing market-leading data solutions into its Packaging Compliance Scheme, used by over 450 UK businesses.
seoTitle: Veolia announces strategic alliance with Ecoveritas | Press release
seoDescription: Veolia and Ecoveritas form an alliance bringing audit-ready packaging data and reporting to Veolia's Packaging Compliance Scheme, used by over 450 UK businesses.
